_what_this_is: Gate 11's destination assertions. A 2xx is not enough: the personal fork published as the project's PyPI Homepage returns 200 while being the wrong destination (C-5). `expected` is the URL each copy.yaml:urls key must resolve to after redirects. `published_elsewhere` is the set of URLs the project publishes on other surfaces, checked here so their state is on the record. THIS IS NOT AN ALLOW-LIST. Entries in published_elsewhere are expected to FAIL, and the failure is the point: it is the standing record that the metadata is still wrong somewhere the site does not control. Do not add anything here to make the gate green.
